title: AceTheRound Interview Prep Workshop
description: An online workshop with AceTheRound on how interviews for investment banking, private equity and hedge fund roles are really assessed.
fullDescription:
AIS hosted an online interview preparation workshop with AceTheRound, led by its co-founder, a former investment banker at Centerview in London. The session went behind the scenes of recruiting for investment banking, private equity and hedge funds and showed how interviews are really assessed.
Participants learned why strong candidates fail, how interviewers evaluate structure and performance under pressure, and took away practical frameworks they can apply immediately.
keyTakeaways: How interviewers assess structure and performance under pressure
Practical frameworks for IB, PE and HF interviews
